method.signal: bull/negative divergence <= -1.5 sigma + corr>=0.25 + positive ratio-leading corr>=0.25
method.regime_gate: NOT_HIGH_VOL: trailing 20d realized-vol percentile <70% using trailing 252 sessions
method.bootstrap: event-level bootstrap, 20000 resamples, fixed seed; baseline mean treated as reference population
method.rolling_windows: fixed-rule stability diagnostics only; overlapping windows are not independent OOS folds
method.holdout_2020_plus: same frozen rule evaluated from 2020-01-01 onward
